description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of git repository cloning, including local clones, clones with specific options, bundles, empty repositories, error cases, and non-Git directories. It contains test cases with setup, execution, and verification steps leveraging git commands and custom functions.

methods.name: repo_is_hardlinked
methods.description: Check if the given repository directory '1' is linked via hard links by counting files with only one link in the objects directory.
